title.zh: 桑普号破冰船与冰雪城堡信息
火车时刻表（罗瓦涅米-凯米）

summary.en: Kemi is located on the coast of the Bothnian Bay. The wind coming off the frozen sea makes the 'real feel' temperature significantly colder than inland Lapland.
summary.zh: 凯米位于波的尼亚湾沿岸。从冰冻海面吹来的风使得体感温度比内陆拉普兰要冷得多。

mitigations.zh: 防风外层是绝对不可协商的必须品。

mitigations.en: Cover all exposed skin to prevent windburn.
mitigations.zh: 遮盖所有裸露的皮肤以防风灼伤。

summary.en: Walking on the frozen sea is popular, but active shipping lanes exist (kept open by icebreakers). The ice near these lanes is unstable and dangerous.
summary.zh: 在冰冻的海面上行走很受欢迎，但存在活跃的航道（由破冰船保持开通）。这些航道附近的冰层不稳定且危险。

mitigations.en: Only walk on marked ice tracks or with a guide.
mitigations.zh: 只在标记的冰道上行走或跟随向导。

mitigations.en: Stay far away from open water channels created by ships.
mitigations.zh: 远离船只开辟的开阔水道。

items.en: Book Icebreaker Cruise (Sampo or Arktis) 3-4 months ahead.
items.zh: 提前 3-4 个月预订破冰船巡游（桑普号 Sampo 或 Arktis 号）。

items.en: Check height requirement for ice floating (usually min 145cm).
items.zh: 检查冰海漂浮的身高要求（通常最低 145cm）。

items.en: Train tickets Rovaniemi <-> Kemi (VR trains are reliable but schedule is fixed).
items.zh: 罗瓦涅米 <-> 凯米的火车票（VR 火车很可靠，但时刻表是固定的）。

message.en: Safety survival suits for ice floating have minimum height requirements (typically 145cm / 4ft 9in) for the seal to work properly. Small children cannot float in the sea.
message.zh: 冰海漂浮的安全救生服有最低身高要求（通常为 145cm），以确保密封性正常工作。小孩不能在海里漂浮。

askUser.en: Does everyone in your party meet the 145cm height requirement?
askUser.zh: 您团队中的每个人都达到 145cm 的身高要求了吗？

message.en: The actual 'SnowCastle' (made of snow/ice) is built annually and usually opens late Jan to April. However, the 'SnowExperience365' (indoor cold room) and Glass Villas are open year-round.
message.zh: 真正的"冰雪城堡"（由雪/冰制成）每年建造一次，通常在 1 月底至 4 月开放。但是，"SnowExperience365"（室内冷室）和玻璃别墅全年开放。

title.en: Verify SnowCastle opening date if visiting in Jan
title.zh: 如果在 1 月访问，请核实冰雪城堡的开放日期
